cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the farewell cake to me. How many years am I putting round the edge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ten. I'm not telling you who's leaving yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ten it is. No name needed. Which department's colour shall I use?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Plain icing. You'll work it out from the colour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Plain, then. I'll cut the slices too; does our guest need the gluten-free knife?

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 protect the secret with concrete limits on usable clues.

heightening.evidence: A5 keeps the hidden-fact pursuit but its knife detail is a needless technical distraction.

specificity.evidence: A1 farewell cake is clear; A5 gluten-free knife raises the unaddressed cake ingredients.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 concise concession works; A5 extra slicing commitment and tool obscure a simpler ingredient question.
